text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the testing procedure P1, 
which performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block
Cards of Diamo (K), which is responsible for 
protection auxiliaries of unit (air fan, gas recirculation fan, condensate pump, 
feed water pump..etc.). All of those cards have a special programming unit, 
which were putting in position (A), while the tested card putting in position 
(B) see figure (1).
The first draft initiated by eng. Ramadan Helmy, tested at 04 
May 2003, revised by quality control eng. Abdl Menem Al Emam at EDEPCo., 
accepted by: eng. Aly Abd Elwhab, and approved by eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy - Head 
Sector of talkha power station
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes, etc.
Turbine must be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
The portable automatic DIAMO unit tester ATU P1 used for testing and verifying the logic units DIAMO.
Work to be Carried Out
Press (START) tester with press (ON) push bottom of tested card.
Press push bottom (OFF) in tested card with press (START) of tester.
Press both switch (ON) + (OFF) on tested card at the same time with press 
 (START) in tester, wait up to the mark (END) appear in display

0031A13 | Fuse | Replace fuse
0062A90 | Power supply(220v) cutting | Check power supply
